items.t: Timing chain stretch on the 3.0L V6
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Owners report about $1,800-$4,000; CarComplaints lists a typical $2,450.

items.t: Timing chain problems on the 3.6L V6
items.job: Replace timing chains and tensioners
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $3,500.

items.t: Automatic transmission failure
items.job: Replace transmission with a rebuilt unit
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical $2,000-$2,250.

items.t: Water or condensation inside the headlights
items.job: Replace headlight assembly
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical $1,600 per side; the bumper often has to come off.

items.t: Low-beam headlights too dim
items.job: Replace headlight assembly
items.note: CarComplaints lists typical costs from about $600 to $1,900.

items.t: CUE touchscreen stops responding or cracks
items.job: Replace CUE touch screen panel
items.note: CarComplaints lists typical costs of $600-$1,200.

items.t: Ratcheting noise from the transfer case
items.job: Replace or rebuild transfer case
items.note: Based on owner-reported costs at TrueDelta for 2004–2007 SRXs: about $1,000–$2,000 for a replaced or rebuilt transfer case; no parts-plus-labor source found.

items.t: Brakes and rotors wear out early
items.job: Replace brake pads and rotors
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $800.

items.t: Wheel hub bearing failure
items.job: Replace one wheel hub bearing assembly
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $700.

items.t: A/C compressor failure
items.job: Replace A/C compressor and recharge
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $1,100.

items.t: Catalytic converter failure
items.job: Replace catalytic converter
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $1,000.

items.t: Tires wearing out early
items.job: Replace tires and align
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $800.

items.t: Engine revs and lurches forward while stopped
items.job: Replace electronic throttle body
items.note: Only if testing points to the throttle body. Based on estimators: RepairPal $572–$740 for 2008–2009; YourMechanic about $808 for a 2008 V8. No parts-plus-labor source found.

items.t: Sunroof leaks water inside
items.job: Clear or reconnect sunroof drain tubes
items.note: Based on owner-reported costs at TrueDelta for first-generation SRXs: $168 to clear a clogged drain, $524 for a loose drain hose and water damage. Wet carpet or electrical damage costs more.
